hypotheses.K1_primary_knn_is_predictive: The preregistered 128D, 8-neighbor router reaches median score correlation at least 0.85 on every corpus.
hypotheses.K2_primary_knn_beats_quadratic: The primary router exceeds the 128D quadratic router by at least 0.03 correlation on every corpus.
hypotheses.K3_primary_knn_approaches_oracle: The primary router is within 0.05 correlation of the oracle on every corpus.
hypotheses.K4_primary_knn_recovers_support: The primary router recalls at least 50% of oracle top-16 support on every corpus.
hypotheses.K5_primary_knn_transfers_ood: Primary-router correlation drops by at most 0.05 from FineWeb on each OOD corpus.
